svg.title: BH wells on SPY, QQQ and DIA
svg.desc: Daily closes for the last 750 days of the bundled data with black-hole active periods shaded and BH mass below each price panel, as computed by examples/bh_quickstart.py.
svg.text: Shaded: BlackHoleDetector reports an active well. Dashed: formation threshold. Descriptive, one historical sample, not a backtest.
